title: openclaw/openclaw
title_zh: OpenClaw 开源 AI 助手：在你的设备上、在你的聊天中运行

paragraphs.en: The AI that really does things. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
paragraphs.zh: 真正能做事的 AI。任何操作系统。任何平台。龙虾之道。🦞

paragraphs.en: OpenClaw is an open-source AI assistant that runs on your own computer and meets you in the channels you already use: Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram, WhatsApp, and 20+ more, plus native apps for macOS, iOS, Android, Windows, and Linux. One Gateway runs it as a personal assistant on a laptop or as a shared team deployment ; configuration is the only difference.
paragraphs.zh: OpenClaw 是一款开源 AI 助手，它运行在你自己的电脑上，并通过你已经在使用的渠道与你相见：Discord、iMessage、Slack、Teams、Telegram、WhatsApp 以及 20 多个其他渠道，此外还有适用于 macOS、iOS、Android、Windows 和 Linux 的原生应用。 一个网关既可以把它作为个人助手运行在笔记本电脑上，也可以作为团队共享部署运行；唯一的区别在于配置。

sents.en: OpenClaw is an open-source AI assistant that runs on your own computer and meets you in the channels you already use: Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram, WhatsApp, and 20+ more, plus native apps for macOS, iOS, Android, Windows, and Linux.
sents.zh: OpenClaw 是一款开源 AI 助手，它运行在你自己的电脑上，并通过你已经在使用的渠道与你相见：Discord、iMessage、Slack、Teams、Telegram、WhatsApp 以及 20 多个其他渠道，此外还有适用于 macOS、iOS、Android、Windows 和 Linux 的原生应用。

sents.en: One Gateway runs it as a personal assistant on a laptop or as a shared team deployment ; configuration is the only difference.
sents.zh: 一个网关既可以把它作为个人助手运行在笔记本电脑上，也可以作为团队共享部署运行；唯一的区别在于配置。

paragraphs.en: Yours, with no catch. State, memory, and credentials live on your hardware. Models and agent harnesses (Claude, Codex, local models) are plugins you can swap without changing anything else. Your prompts go to the model provider and chat platforms you configure, plus any diagnostics export you enable yourself; by default OpenClaw itself phones home for nothing but a daily version check, anonymous feature statistics are opt-in, and update.checkOnStart: false disables both ( what OpenClaw sends ). OpenClaw is stewarded by the OpenClaw Foundation , an independent 501(c)(3), and has no paid tier, hosted service, or token. The architecture case — trusted gateway, untrusted execution, policy enforced by code — is in Why OpenClaw .
paragraphs.zh: 归你所有，没有隐藏条件。 状态、记忆与凭证都保存在你自己的硬件上。 模型和智能体框架（Claude、Codex、本地模型）都是插件，可以随意替换而不必改动其他任何东西。 你的提示词只会发送给你配置的模型提供商和聊天平台，以及你自己启用的诊断导出；默认情况下，OpenClaw 本身除了每日一次的版本检查外不会回传任何数据，匿名功能统计为可选加入，而 update.checkOnStart: false 可将两者一并禁用（OpenClaw 发送哪些内容）。 OpenClaw 由 OpenClaw 基金会（一个独立的 501(c)(3) 组织）管理，没有付费版、托管服务或代币。 其架构论证——可信网关、不可信执行、由代码强制执行策略——见《为什么选择 OpenClaw》。

paragraphs.en: The installer supports macOS, Linux, and Windows. It provisions a supported Node.js runtime when needed.
paragraphs.zh: 安装程序支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。 它会在需要时配置一个受支持的 Node.js 运行时。

sents.en: The installer supports macOS, Linux, and Windows.
sents.zh: 安装程序支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。

sents.en: It provisions a supported Node.js runtime when needed.
sents.zh: 它会在需要时配置一个受支持的 Node.js 运行时。

paragraphs.en: # macOS / Linux / WSL2 curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash # Windows PowerShell iwr - useb https: // openclaw.ai / install.ps1 | iex Already manage Node.js? Install the published package instead (Node 24.16+ or 26.1+; Node 26 recommended):
paragraphs.zh: # macOS / Linux / WSL2 curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash # Windows PowerShell iwr -useb https://openclaw.ai/install.ps1 | iex 已经在管理 Node.js 了？ 也可以安装已发布的软件包（需要 Node 24.16+ 或 26.1+；推荐 Node 26）：

sents.en: # macOS / Linux / WSL2 curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash # Windows PowerShell iwr - useb https: // openclaw.ai / install.ps1 | iex Already manage Node.js?
sents.zh: # macOS / Linux / WSL2 curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash # Windows PowerShell iwr -useb https://openclaw.ai/install.ps1 | iex 已经在管理 Node.js 了？

sents.en: Install the published package instead (Node 24.16+ or 26.1+; Node 26 recommended):
sents.zh: 也可以安装已发布的软件包（需要 Node 24.16+ 或 26.1+；推荐 Node 26）：

paragraphs.en: npm install -g openclaw@latest --allow-scripts=openclaw That command is for npm 12 or npm 11.16+. On npm 11.15 and earlier, omit --allow-scripts=openclaw . See the installation guide for the lifecycle script contract, Docker, Nix, and other deployment paths.
paragraphs.zh: npm install -g openclaw@latest --allow-scripts=openclaw 该命令适用于 npm 12 或 npm 11.16+。 在 npm 11.15 及更早版本上，请省略 --allow-scripts=openclaw。 生命周期脚本约定、Docker、Nix 及其他部署路径请参阅安装指南。

paragraphs.en: On a fresh install, the installer scripts start onboarding automatically. Complete the wizard they open. If you installed the package directly with npm, pnpm, or Bun, run:
paragraphs.zh: 在全新安装时，安装脚本会自动启动引导流程。 完成它们打开的设置向导。 如果你直接使用 npm、pnpm 或 Bun 安装了软件包，请运行：

sents.en: On a fresh install, the installer scripts start onboarding automatically.
sents.zh: 在全新安装时，安装脚本会自动启动引导流程。

sents.en: Complete the wizard they open.
sents.zh: 完成它们打开的设置向导。

sents.en: If you installed the package directly with npm, pnpm, or Bun, run:
sents.zh: 如果你直接使用 npm、pnpm 或 Bun 安装了软件包，请运行：

paragraphs.en: openclaw onboard --install-daemon After onboarding:
paragraphs.zh: openclaw onboard --install-daemon 完成引导后：

paragraphs.en: openclaw gateway status openclaw dashboard Onboarding verifies model access, creates the workspace, and configures the Gateway. The last command opens the Control UI; send a message there to confirm the assistant is working. See the getting started guide for channel setup and troubleshooting.
paragraphs.zh: openclaw gateway status openclaw dashboard 入门引导会验证模型访问权限、创建工作区，并配置网关。 最后一条命令会打开控制界面；在那里发送一条消息以确认智能体正常工作。 有关渠道设置和故障排除，请参阅入门指南。

sents.en: openclaw gateway status openclaw dashboard Onboarding verifies model access, creates the workspace, and configures the Gateway.
sents.zh: openclaw gateway status openclaw dashboard 入门引导会验证模型访问权限、创建工作区，并配置网关。

sents.zh: 最后一条命令会打开控制界面；在那里发送一条消息以确认智能体正常工作。

sents.zh: 有关渠道设置和故障排除，请参阅入门指南。

paragraphs.en: OpenClaw works with hosted and local model providers . Its tools , skills , and plugins extend what an assistant can do.
paragraphs.zh: OpenClaw 支持托管和本地模型提供商。 它的工具、技能和插件扩展了智能体能做的事情。

paragraphs.en: Treat inbound messages as untrusted input. DM-capable channels pair unknown senders by default; approve a pairing request with openclaw pairing approve <channel> <code> .
paragraphs.zh: 将入站消息视为不可信的输入。 支持私信（DM）的频道默认会与未知发送者配对；使用 openclaw pairing approve <channel> <code> 批准配对请求。

paragraphs.en: Tools run on the host for the main session unless you configure sandboxing. Read the security guide , exposure runbook , and sandboxing guide before connecting other users or exposing the Gateway remotely.
paragraphs.zh: 工具默认在宿主机上为主会话运行，除非你配置了沙箱。 在连接其他用户或远程暴露网关之前，请先阅读安全指南、暴露操作手册和沙箱指南。

paragraphs.en: git clone https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw.git cd openclaw pnpm install pnpm build pnpm ui:build See CONTRIBUTING.md for the contribution workflow and the source setup guide for the development loop.

paragraphs.en: OpenClaw is developed in the open by the OpenClaw Foundation , an independent 501(c)(3). The Foundation employs the core team and signs releases. Donors and infrastructure sponsors support the Foundation; none of them own or direct the project. OpenAI is a donor, not an owner.
paragraphs.zh: OpenClaw 由独立 501(c)(3) 组织 OpenClaw 基金会在开放环境中开发。 该基金会雇佣核心团队并对发布版本进行签名。 捐赠者和基础设施赞助者为基金会提供支持；他们中没有任何人拥有或指导该项目。 OpenAI 是捐赠者，而非所有者。

paragraphs.en: Use the issue chooser for bugs and feature requests, get official OpenClaw support at community.openclaw.ai , and report vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md . New capabilities usually belong in plugins built on the plugin SDK and shared through ClawHub .
paragraphs.zh: 请使用 issue 选择器提交 bug 和功能请求，在 community.openclaw.ai 获取 OpenClaw 官方支持，并通过 SECURITY.md 报告安全漏洞。 新功能通常应放在基于插件 SDK 构建的插件中，并通过 ClawHub 分享。
